confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Denver price levels, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel rates, which vary by season, events and availability. July is peak season for Denver lodging, so accommodation anchors may be high or low by 20% or more. Tip is excluded from the restaurant anchors. FX is the RBA USD per AUD figure for 15 Oct 2026 as reported in search results; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Denver was estimated against other mid-sized US Mountain West and Pacific Northwest metros with strong summer tourism, such as Portland, Oregon and Salt Lake City, Utah, adjusted for Denver's own restaurant, bar and lodging price levels.
